name: Reaper's Rite
source:
A young man is confronted by his own mortality -- along with the demon he's been sentenced to seal -- as he contemplates whether to fulfil his farming family's ritual sacrifice.

[From [url=https://fiendishfiction.itch.io/reapersrite]Itch.io[/url]]
